Package com.codeup.novabook.repo.impl

Class ConfigRepositoryImpl

java.lang.Object
com.codeup.novabook.repo.impl.ConfigRepositoryImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
IConfigRepository, IGeneralRepository<SystemConfig,Integer>
public class ConfigRepositoryImpl extends Object implements IConfigRepository
JDBC implementation of the IConfigRepository interface using JdbcTemplateLight.

This repository manages SystemConfig entities for system-wide configuration parameters. Provides key-based retrieval and update operations for runtime configuration.

Key Features:

  • Key-based configuration lookup
  • Editable configuration filtering
  • Atomic configuration value updates
  • Type-safe configuration retrieval
